object_selection: Select two visually identifiable static furnishings or architectural elements visible in the first frozen frame. Track the same identities in all six frames; do not replace a difficult object later.
box_definition: Axis-aligned [left, top, right, bottom] in original 960x540 pixels, enclosing only the observed visible extent of the named object. Never infer a hidden/amodal box. Rectangles contain background and are not segmentation masks.
missing_policy: Out-of-frame or uncertain identity has bbox null and an explicit reason. Partial occlusion/truncation is retained as partial, with the visible extent only. All 36 observations remain in the inventory.
annotation_provenance: Manual visual estimates by internal agents from hash-bound lossy display previews. Original PNG hashes remain authoritative. These are model-authored annotations, not independent human-reviewed labels.
review_budget: One initial pass per source and one overlay review/correction pass; retain initial submissions and all changes. No reconstruction score is used to select labels.
data_role: development_fit; all 18 frames were previously used for SfM, none is held out
scope: Visible bounding-box diagnostic preparation only. No masks, metric geometry, calibration, material labels, complete scene inventory, common editable initialization, or benchmark accuracy is established.
